preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 200,000.
The number of friends N must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.
The number of slices per pizza K must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum number of pizzas required to distribute the slices evenly among N friends.

raw_response: {"interface":{"mode":"stdin_stdout","signature":"stdin -> stdout"},"preconditions":[{"id":"P1","expression":"1 <= T <= 2 * 10**5","description":"The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 200,000."},{"id":"P2","expression":"1 <= N <= 10**9","description":"The number of friends N must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000."},{"id":"P3","expression":"1 <= K <= 10**9","description":"The number of slices per pizza K must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000."}],"postconditions":[{"id":"Q1","expression":"stdout == str((N + K - 1) // K)","description":"The output must be the minimum number of pizzas required to distribute the slices evenly among N friends."}],"invariants":[]}
